svg.title: OSDU Delivery: Dynamic diagram: a commit becomes the runs that execute it
svg.desc: Nothing runs from a working copy: a run executes the commit the control plane synced, checked out on the node with a token the GitHub App mints for that repository alone.
svg.text: Dynamic diagram: a commit becomes the runs that execute it
Nothing runs from a working copy: a run executes the commit the control plane synced, checked out on the node with a token the GitHub App mints for that

g.title: Pipeline developer: Writes the estate's flows, mappings, templates, schedules, assertions and AI contexts in VS Code, checks and previews them against the synced estate, and pushes them to the estate repository.

Estate repository: The estate as YAML and JSON files in git: flows, mappings, templates, cache definitions, schedules, assertions and AI contexts. A run executes the commit the control plane last synced, never a working copy.

Key Vault: osdu-kv-<suffix>, RBAC only. Terraform writes the connection strings (no credential in them); the setup script generates the JWT signing key, the first admin's password and the node token when missing; a person puts in each partition's client secret and the GitHub App's key.

VS Code extension: Makes the editor the place a pipeline is developed: the GUI's pages in tabs, completion and checks for every flow, mapping and template, a mapping's preview from the open file, and one sign-in it shares with the command line and the MCP server.

GitHub Actions: A job proves who it is with the OpenID Connect token GitHub mints for it, for the audience the control plane names, and makes trigger requests: sync this repository at this commit, then fire these schedules. Nothing secret is stored.

Repository sync: The managed git sync: reads the commit a trigger names, the branch's tip on a person's request, or every interval when auto sync is on; validates every document; writes the catalog's rows and, through DeliveryCatalogSync, the module's mappings, cache definitions and interfaces; recomputes lineage. It only moves forward.

Scheduler: Fires the schedules the estate declares (in order within a schedule), queues runs each pinned to the commit last synced, splits a large delivery into parts on nodes of their own, and dispatches under a lease, which is why the control plane runs as one replica.

Node runtime: SQLFlow's worker verb with the module installed: polls the control plane with its node token, takes runs and node tasks into its slots (four by default), checks out the commit each run is pinned to, resolves ${env:...} and ${keyvault:...} references with its own identity, and drains running work before it stops.
g.text: Polls, runs four at once, resolves

g.title: Catalog database: OsduDelivery: SQLFlow's catalog (pipelines, runs, schedules, lineage, users, conversations) and, beside it, the osdu schema with its own migrations: the ledger, the audit trail, cache versions, the index of the repository's templates, partitions and the central configuration.
